2.jpg.title: Shift-P, Landscaping, Mass Tree Exterminator
2.jpg.text: Click two opposite corners: the trees and bushes in the area are counted and priced.

3.jpg.title: One confirmation, one bill
3.jpg.text: Every tree costs what the game's bulldozer charges for it, bushes are charged per square metre.

4.jpg.title: The whole area at once
4.jpg.text: 151 trees and their stumps gone in one go. Trees on land that is not yours stay.
